summary.text: David Richter is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 1 since December 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: David Richter assumed office in the North Dakota House of Representatives on December 1, 2018, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.

Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in 2019-2020 as House Agriculture and House Industry, Business and Labor, in 2021-2022 as House Agriculture and House Education, and in 2023-2024 as Appropriations - Education and Environment.
